cues.text: A thirty-five-year-old man has a routine annual medical examination for his employment.
His ECG shows prolongation of the PR interval, to more than 0.22 seconds.
A prolonged PR interval like this is first-degree AV block.
First-degree AV block indicates an abnormality at the AV node.
And the AV node is situated in the right atrium.
So the abnormal part of the conducting system lies in the right atrium.
